messages:
elena: Quick rollcall for Friday's release wave — 10:00–12:00 PT. Who's owning the mobile-telemetry and infra-config slots? Please confirm smoke scripts + rollback branch/tag for your PRs. Need final ack by 09:30 PT.

Tariq: I'll own mobile-telemetry, target slot 10:15. Smoke script added to runbook: `scripts/smoke_mobile.sh`. Rollback branch `rollback/mobile-telemetry/v1.3` created. :thumbsup:

Hannah: I can pick infra-config at 10:45. Adding myself as smoke owner. Pinged @leo for CR.

Leo: CR submitted — https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821. Build passed on CI. No DB migration. Rollback image tag `infra-config:20260310-prev` ready. Canaries: start at 10% for first 5m, then 50% if stable.

Aisha: I'll own post-deploy checks (15m) — health, p95 latency, error-rate. Quick checklist I run:
```
# post-deploy smoke
curl -sS https://staging.health/ready | grep OK
kubectl get pods -l app=mobile -n prod | grep Running
slo-check --env prod --metric latency --threshold 20ms
```

Elena: Perfect. Can we add an automated fallback to prev image if p95 > 20ms for 3 consecutive minutes? Update runbook and add a fast rollback step.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release wave scheduled Fri 10:00 PT. Please post final ack in thread by 09:30 PT.

Tariq: ack — I'll be online from 09:30 PT. Will also monitor logs for obvious token errors.

Hannah: ack. I'll have smoke outputs in #eng-sre as well.

Elena: Thanks — tagging owners in the wave doc: @tariq (mobile-telemetry), @hannah (infra-config), @aisha (post-checks). See wave checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/release/wave-2026-03-12

ci-bot: Build status: all green for PRs referenced in this thread.
